actions.reason: K2_C0001 has an interpretable biological phenotype (oxidative-phosphorylation/mitochondrial program with coordinated immune and proliferative axes), but biological identity alone does not establish independent membership. Evidence directly bearing on membership and boundary is weak and unsupportive: the pair structural diagnostic reports a fused boundary silhouette of essentially zero (0.00030) with between-set affinity (0.00902) barely below within-set affinity (0.00932), and the set-level native-geometry alignment shows small silhouettes across all four modalities (CT 0.013, RNA 0.079, WSI 0.050, WXS 0.091) with within-set distances only marginally below between-set distances. The current membership is therefore only weakly expressed as a distinct unit, and no positive candidate-specific membership evidence offsets this. Merge is not a legal structural action in this workflow, so the weak boundary cannot be repaired by union; no decision-changing uncertainty remains that an available request could resolve.
